name: Amariah
overview: Amariah was a male biblical figure known primarily as the great-grandfather of the prophet Zephaniah. While his tribal affiliation is not specified, he is noted for his place within a significant prophetic lineage. There are no additional personal notes recorded about him.
namesAndTitles: The name Amariah means 'Yahweh has said,' reflecting a theophoric element that acknowledges God's authority. This name is a proper name mentioned explicitly in Zephaniah 1:1, but it was not given directly by God.
familyAndRelationships: Scripture records Amariah as the father of Gedaliah and the son of Hezekiah, establishing him within a family line that leads to the prophet Zephaniah. These relationships are found explicitly or inferred in Zephaniah 1:1. No other family connections are documented.
scriptureSignificance: Amariah's significance lies in his role within the ancestral line of the prophet Zephaniah, anchoring the prophetic ministry in a historical and familial context. His mention in Zephaniah 1:1 situates him as a link in the transmission of God's word through generations. Though not a prominent figure by his own actions, his genealogical position underscores the continuity of God's revelation to His people.
